finalText:
The parent component is probably re-rendering — that causes the child to re-render by default, even if the props look the same.

Watch for props that are objects or functions. If the parent creates them fresh each render (like `onClick={() => ...}` or `items={[]}`), the child sees a new reference every time, which counts as a prop change.

The fixes are:
- Wrap the child with `React.memo()` to skip re-renders when props don't actually change.
- Move objects and functions outside the render, or use `useCallback` and `useMemo` to keep the same reference between renders.

If you share the component code, I can spot the exact cause.
